name: Eosforit
source: The game takes place in a fantasy world resembling the 19th century. In the Kingdom of Seraphinite, you must investigate the murder of your uncle, from whom you've inherited a house, debts, and a mysterious pendant — Eosphorite. Your choices will determine who stays by the heroine's side, whether she uncovers the killer, and if she survives at all.
